en: The postcard features a detailed illustrated map of the Vallée de la Couze-Chambon, highlighting various towns, castles, and natural features in the valley. Key locations such as Château de Murol and Portel Chastel are depicted with small sketches. The landscape is mountainous, with rivers and valleys clearly drawn. On the right side, there is a block of printed text in French describing the valley and its landmarks. Several landmarks and roadways are labeled, and the illustration includes people in a boat on the water.
